question: As on September 2021, which of the following is NOT a national political party in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian National Lok Dal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Indian National Lok Dal (INLD) is a **regional political party** in India primarily active in the state of Haryana.
 
• The party was founded in 1996 by Om Prakash Chautala, a prominent politician from Haryana.
